info.title: Sphericon StaffMember API
info.description: The API of the platform Staff console (Enterprise): sign-in with a password and a TOTP, and the cross-workspace views and actions of a Staff member.

post.description:
Check the password. Answers a challenge (or, at first login, a TOTP enrolment)
and never a session. Unknown email and wrong password answer the same 401.

429.description: RFC 7807 too many requests response: a rate limit was exceeded (ADR 0025)

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: The request budget of the window that was exceeded

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix time at which the window resets

post.description:
End the session: bumps the Staff member's session epoch, so every session token of
the Staff member (a copied one too) stops verifying, and clears the session cookie.

204.description: There is no content to send for this request, but the headers may be useful.

post.description:
The second login step: verify the challenge and a TOTP code, then start the
session (the cookie is set here). At first login the code also confirms the
enrolment. An expired, reused or forged challenge and a wrong code answer the
same 401.

429.description: RFC 7807 too many requests response: a rate limit was exceeded (ADR 0025)

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: The request budget of the window that was exceeded

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix time at which the window resets

get.description: The Sign-up survey answers, counted per question. Read only.
One User's answers. 404 when the User is unknown or has not answered the survey.
List all Workspaces, newest first, optionally narrowed by an id or name search
One Workspace's metadata, suspension state, rates and send volume
One Workspace's Audit log, newest first. Empty when the instance has no Audit license, since nothing is then recorded.

post.description:
Exempt a Workspace from the abuse detector (ADR 0026): it is neither warned nor
frozen automatically, but stays listed with its rates and can still be suspended by
hand. Audited. Idempotent.

Suspend a Workspace's outbound sending (ADR 0007) with a required reason, as the
signed-in Staff member. Idempotent: an already-suspended Workspace is left as it was.
Police a Workspace by the abuse detector again. Audited. Idempotent.

Lift a Workspace's suspension; held sends resume. Idempotent: a Workspace that is
not suspended is left as it was.

StaffWorkspaceSearch.review.name: review
StaffWorkspaceSearch.review.description: Only Workspaces in this review state

StaffWorkspaceSearch.search.name: search
StaffWorkspaceSearch.search.description:
Only Workspaces whose id or name contains this text; the name matches case-insensitively,
the id exactly

EntityId.description:
A primary key, written as a decimal string so JavaScript never rounds it. The format
makes the Go servers parse it into an int64: a malformed id is refused as a 400 before
a handler runs. The pattern says the same in the contract, so a client (or a fuzzer) can
tell a malformed id from a valid one without trying it. Eighteen digits is the most a key
reaches, so every id the schema admits fits an int64.

GoneProblem.description: RFC 7807 gone response: the resource existed but is no longer available (an expired link)

InUseProblem.description:
RFC 7807 conflict response for a removal refused because live work still uses the row
(ADR 0049): 409 with `usedBy` naming the users. Every refused removal of a Segment, Tag,
Integration, Sending domain or Automation answers it.

code.description: Why the request was refused, when the client should act on it

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence

retryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying; set on a 429 so a client that only sees the body can show the wait

debug.description: Why a 500 happened, sent only by a development server (`SPHERICON_ENV=development`)

usedBy.description: The live rows that use the one a removal was refused for, never empty

InUseProblemDetails.description: The body of a refused removal (ADR 0049): ProblemDetails plus the rows that use it

PaymentRequiredProblem.description: RFC 7807 payment required response: the feature needs an Enterprise license

PreconditionRequiredProblem.description:
RFC 7807 precondition required response: the request needs something it did not carry
(a verification link opened outside its Sign-up browser needs a password, ADR 0030)

ProblemCode.description: A machine-readable reason a client branches on, beyond the HTTP status

error.description: The error that failed the request, or the panic value

stack.description: The goroutine stack of a panic; absent for an error a handler returned

requestId.description: The request id the server log carries for this request

method.description: The HTTP method of the failed request

path.description: The path of the failed request

ProblemDebug.description:
What a development server adds to a 500 so the page can show the fault; a production
Instance never sends it

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence

retryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying; set on a 429 so a client that only sees the body can show the wait

debug.description: Why a 500 happened, sent only by a development server (`SPHERICON_ENV=development`)

exempt.description: Exempt from the detector: neither warned nor frozen automatically

clearedAt.description: When a Staff member last lifted a suspension; the detector counts only Events after it

warningNotifiedAt.description: When the owners were told of the current warning; absent outside an episode

freezeNotifiedAt.description: When the owners were last told of a suspension

warning.description: Present while the Workspace is in the warning tier, computed now

StaffAbuse.description: A Workspace's standing with the abuse detector (ADR 0026)

StaffAbuseMetric.description: Which metric of a Sending domain breached the abuse detector's warning limit

StaffAbuseWarning.description: A Sending domain in the warning tier (ADR 0026), by the detector's own computation

kind.description: The kind of actor; a staff member carries no id and the name "Sphericon staff"; a service is a Service credential, named as the Staff member who issued it chose

id.description: The actor's id (a User id or an API token id); absent for the system and a staff member

name.description: Display name snapshot taken when the entry was written

StaffAuditActor.description: The actor of an Audit entry

StaffAuditActorKind.description: Who performed an audited change, as the Workspace's own team sees it

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page

StaffAuditEntryList.description: A page of a Workspace's Audit log, newest first

userAgent.description: Client user agent of the change

StaffAuditEntryResource.description: One immutable Audit entry of a Workspace. Secrets are never recorded; they appear as changed only.

name.description: Name snapshot taken when the entry was written

StaffAuditTarget.description: What an audited change was done to

windowHours.description: Length of the trailing window, in hours

volumeFloor.description: Fewest sends in the window (per Sending domain) for a rate to be defined

sendVolume.description: Messages sent in the window across all Sending domains

domains.description: One entry per Sending domain, oldest first

StaffDeliverability.description:
A Workspace's deliverability over the trailing window: the rates of ADR 0011 per
Sending domain, and how much it sent. Counts only, never message content.

domain.description: The domain the rates are for

complaintRate.description: Complaints over delivered mail; the rate is null when nothing was delivered in the window

StaffDomainRates.description: The Complaint and Bounce rates of one Sending domain over the trailing window

qrCode.description: PNG data URI of the URI

StaffEnrolment.description: A TOTP secret awaiting its first confirming code

StaffExemptionChange.description:
The outcome of an exempt or un-exempt: the Workspace as it now stands, and whether
anything changed

key.description: Unique per Workspace, chosen by the setter

message.description: The message the setter gave for the Owner

createdAt.description: When the hold was first set

expiresAt.description: When the hold lapses unless renewed

setBy.description: Who set it: the name of its Service credential

actionUrl.description: Where an Owner or Admin can resolve the hold, as the setter gave it; absent when none was given

StaffHold.description: An active Staff hold on a Workspace, as the console shows it (read only)

StaffLoginInput.description:
Sign in with an email and password. The email is a plain string: a malformed
address must answer like an unknown one.

StaffLoginOutcome.description:
What the password step granted. There is never a session at this step: a TOTP is
mandatory (ADR 0026). `challenge`: the Staff member has a TOTP, go on with a code.
`enrolment`: the Staff member has none yet (first login); the `enrolment` secret is to be
added to an authenticator app, and the first code confirms it.

challenge.description:
The signed challenge for the second step: bound to the Staff member, valid for 5
minutes, working for one successful second step.

denominator.description: The population the rate is over

rate.description:
numerator / denominator; null (undefined) when fewer sends than the volume floor
were made in the window, never reported as 0

StaffRate.description: A rate as the (numerator, denominator, rate) triple (ADR 0011)

StaffResource.description: The authenticated platform Staff member (shown to customers only as "Sphericon staff")

code.description: A current TOTP code from the authenticator app

StaffSecondFactorInput.description: The second login step: the challenge from the password step and a TOTP code

StaffSignupCompanySize.description: How many people work at the User's company (second question)

StaffSignupCompanySizeCount.description: How many Users chose a company size

StaffSignupGoal.description: What the User mainly wants to do with the product (third question)

StaffSignupGoalCount.description: How many Users chose a main goal

StaffSignupOtherTextCount.description: An `other` text and how many Users wrote it

StaffSignupRole.description: What the User does (Sign-up survey, first question)

StaffSignupRoleCount.description: How many Users chose a role

StaffSignupSource.description: Where the User heard about the product (fourth question, optional)

StaffSignupSourceCount.description: How many Users chose a source

responses.description: How many Users answered the survey

heardFrom.description: Only the Users who answered the optional question are counted

StaffSignupSurveyCounts.description:
The Sign-up survey answers of every User who answered, counted per question. A choice nobody
made is absent from its list; a question's `other` texts are listed with their counts, most
frequent first.

roleOtherText.description: What the User does, when `role` is `other`

companySize.description: How many people work at the User's company

mainGoal.description: What the User mainly wants to do with the product

heardFrom.description: Where the User heard about the product; absent when the optional question was skipped

heardFromOtherText.description: Where the User heard about the product, when `heardFrom` is `other`

StaffSignupSurveyResponseResource.description: One User's answers to the Sign-up survey. A User who has not answered has none.

reason.description: The reason, required: the Workspace owner is told why sending stopped

StaffSuspendInput.description: Why a Workspace is being suspended; the owner is told

reason.description: Why, as given by the actor

id.description: The Staff member id; present only for the `staff` kind

StaffSuspensionActor.description: The actor of a suspension. Unlike a customer, a Staff member sees the real Staff member id.

StaffSuspensionChange.description:
The outcome of a suspend or unsuspend: the Workspace as it now stands, and whether
anything changed (suspending a suspended Workspace and unsuspending an active one
change nothing).

id.description: The Workspace id: its short opaque public address (ADR 0043)

discardedAt.description: When the Workspace was deleted; present from deletion until a restore (ADR 0043)

erasedAt.description: When the Workspace's data was erased; the row stays as a tombstone

suspension.description: Present only while sending is suspended

exempt.description: Exempt from the abuse detector (set by a Staff member)

warned.description: The owners were warned and the Workspace has not left the warning tier since

holds.description: Active Staff holds by key; a lapsed hold is not listed

StaffWorkspaceDetailResource.description: A Workspace with its deliverability and active holds, as the detail page shows it

id.description: The Workspace id: its short opaque public address (ADR 0043)

discardedAt.description: When the Workspace was deleted; present from deletion until a restore (ADR 0043)

erasedAt.description: When the Workspace's data was erased; the row stays as a tombstone

suspension.description: Present only while sending is suspended

exempt.description: Exempt from the abuse detector (set by a Staff member)

warned.description: The owners were warned and the Workspace has not left the warning tier since

StaffWorkspaceResource.description:
A Workspace as the Staff console sees it: metadata only, never Contacts,
content or Events (ADR 0026).

StaffWorkspaceReview.description: Which Workspaces the list surfaces for review

kind.description: What kind of row it is

count.description:
How many rows the entry stands for; absent means one. An `enrollment` entry names the
Automation (id, name) and counts its Enrollments; a `message` entry names it and counts its
sent Outbound messages.

UsedBy.description:
A row that uses the one a removal was refused for: what a client shows to say what to
change first

UsedByKind.description:
What kind of row a refused removal names as a user of the row (ADR 0049). One value per kind
of live user a removal can find, so a client branches on it without parsing text.

WorkspaceId.description:
A Workspace id (ADR 0043): 8 random base62 characters, assigned once at creation and the
Workspace's one public address.
